id: 03_Power Tools Safety in hindi Power Tools Hazards & Precautions in hindi
title: 电动工具的危害与预防措施
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/03_Power Tools Safety in hindi Power Tools Hazards & Precautions in hindi.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/03_Power Tools Safety in hindi Power Tools Hazards & Precautions in hindi/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板旁画着电钻和角磨机，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with drawings of an electric drill and an angle grinder, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电动工具。
overlay: 电动工具的危害与预防

shots.scene: 警示三角和盾牌两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons in a row: a yellow warning triangle and a shield with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 它有哪些危害，又该怎么预防。

shots.scene: 工地上，老李把一台角磨机交给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: At a construction site, the facility engineer hands an angle grinder to the young male student.
shots.narration: 阿杰今天要在工地上打磨钢件。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着角磨机，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the angle grinder in his hands with a question mark bubble above him.
shots.narration: 他问：用这个，要注意什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先认识它，再列危害和预防。

shots.scene: 手锯和电锯并排，电锯旁有插头
shots.prompt_en: A hand saw and an electric saw side by side, the electric saw with a power cord and plug. No people.
shots.narration: 不靠人力、靠别的动力驱动的，

shots.scene: 角磨机、钻床、木工切割机、电焊机四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an angle grinder, a drill press, a wood cutting saw and a welding machine. No people.
shots.narration: 就是电动工具，比如这几种。

shots.scene: 电钻电源线冒出小闪电
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electric drill with its cord sparking, with an electric shock warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 工具接着电源，首要危害是触电。

shots.scene: 火焰和爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon and an explosion burst icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，火灾和爆炸。

shots.scene: 砂轮边缘飞出一串火花
shots.prompt_en: Bright sparks flying from the edge of a grinding wheel icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，火花。

shots.scene: 锯片和一只手形图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a saw blade near a hand pictogram with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，割伤，机会可不小。

shots.scene: 火花落在手臂图标上留下红点
shots.prompt_en: An icon of sparks landing on an arm pictogram leaving small red burn marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，打磨火花落身上会烧伤。

shots.scene: 耳朵图标旁边很大的声波
shots.prompt_en: An ear icon with large loud sound waves coming at it. No people.
shots.narration: 第六，噪声大，影响听力。

shots.scene: 握着工具的双手图标，旁边有抖动线
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two hands gripping a vibrating power tool with shaking lines around them. No people.
shots.narration: 第七，振动。

shots.scene: 七个危害图标逐个打勾
shots.prompt_en: Seven small hazard icons in two columns, each getting a check mark one by one: shock, flame, sparks, blade, burn, ear, vibration. No people.
shots.narration: 七种危害，再过一遍。

shots.scene: 工具插在带漏电保护器的插座箱上
shots.prompt_en: A power tool plugged into a site socket box equipped with a residual current breaker with a test button. No people.
shots.narration: 预防一：用110伏降压供电，

shots.scene: 插座箱上的漏电保护器特写
shots.prompt_en: A close view of the residual current breaker on the site socket box. No people.
shots.narration: 并配30毫安的ELCB。

shots.scene: 手松开开关，工具停转
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand releasing the trigger of a drill, and the drill bit stops spinning. No people.
shots.narration: 预防二：开关要松手即停。

shots.scene: 角磨机带着完好的护罩，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An angle grinder with its wheel guard properly in place, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 预防三：机器要有防护罩。

shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱和油桶搬离作业区
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves cardboard boxes and a closed oil drum away from the work area.
shots.narration: 预防四：作业区没有可燃易燃物。

shots.scene: 砂轮片和机器各有空白标签，中间大于号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grinding disc with a blank rating label and a grinder with a blank rating label, with a greater-than symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 预防五：砂轮片额定转速，

shots.scene: 砂轮片高速旋转，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A grinding disc spinning at speed on a grinder, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 必须高于机器的转速。

shots.scene: 作业区用挡板全部围起，火花被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A work area completely surrounded by fire resistant screens, sparks stopped inside. No people.
shots.narration: 预防六：火花百分之百遮挡，

shots.scene: 挡板外干净，没有火花
shots.prompt_en: Outside the fire resistant screens the area is clean, no sparks escape. No people.
shots.narration: 作业区围好，火花飞不出来。

shots.scene: 带挡帘的焊接棚
shots.prompt_en: A welding booth with flame resistant curtains around it, empty. No people.
shots.narration: 预防七：电焊要设焊接棚。

shots.scene: 焊接棚内闪光被挡帘挡住
shots.prompt_en: Bright welding light inside the booth is blocked by the curtains. No people.
shots.narration: 把火花挡在棚里面。

shots.scene: 灭火器标志下有灭火器和灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign above a fire extinguisher and a folded fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 预防八：备好灭火器和灭火毯，

shots.scene: 老李站在作业区旁看护，手边有灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands watch beside a work area with a fire extinguisher at hand.
shots.narration: 还要有受过培训的看火人。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜，再放下面罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and then lowers a clear face shield over them.
shots.narration: 预防九：护目镜加面罩，双重护眼。

shots.scene: 皮手套和围裙图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pair of leather work gloves and a flame resistant apron. No people.
shots.narration: 预防十：戴皮手套、穿围裙。

shots.scene: 耳塞和耳罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pair of foam ear plugs and a pair of ear muffs. No people.
shots.narration: 预防十一：戴耳塞或耳罩。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和两个人形图标交替
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with two person pictograms swapping places with circular arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 预防十二：长时间作业要轮岗。

shots.scene: 老李拍拍阿杰肩膀，换小研接手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps the young male student on the shoulder, and the female graduate student takes over.
shots.narration: 减少每个人的噪声和振动。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现七个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside seven floating hazard icons.
shots.narration: 七种危害：电、火、火花、割烧、噪振。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器、松手开关、防护罩三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a residual current breaker, a trigger switch and a wheel guard. No people.
shots.narration: 降压漏保、松手即停、护罩装好。

shots.scene: 清场、挡板、焊接棚、灭火器四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: an empty clean area, a fire resistant screen, a welding booth and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 清走易燃物、挡火花、备灭火器。

shots.scene: 护目镜、面罩、手套、耳罩四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: safety goggles, a face shield, leather gloves and ear muffs. No people.
shots.narration: 眼、脸、手、耳防护，再加轮岗。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing safety goggles waves goodbye at the camera in front of the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 工具用得对，危害少一半，下次见！
